title: Aruna Ramchandra Shanbaug v. Union of India

content.caseIdentity: Aruna Ramchandra Shanbaug v. Union of India, (2011) 4 SCC 454
content.holding: The historic constitutional ruling examining the legal and medical definition of a "persistent vegetative state" (PVS), providing the jurisprudential foundation for the statutory incorporation of PVS in Section 117(3) BNS.
